messages:
Maya: quick sync — we have a few late deps blocking the v2 deprec timeline, can owners call out blockers?
Rohan: I own SDK shims. blocker: grpc retry semantics changed in v2, found in integration tests. PR open but needs review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/452
Eli: I hit the same in backend routing; fallback shim seems to double-encode metadata for internal proxies. likely a small fix, sending a patch this afternoon.
Natasha: FYI security review wants the auth header name preserved for one extra release for some enterprise customers. can we offer a compat header?
Maya: +1 to compat header. Rohan, can SDK add a temporary header alias (x-rw-auth / authorization) and log a one-time warning?
Rohan: yes, can add alias and warning flag behind env var RW_V2_COMPAT_ALIAS=true. I'll include tests. ETA EOD today for branch, but needs a review window.
deploy-bot: Canary started: canary-cluster-7 running v2-compatible branch (sha: a3f9b2). Observability links: https://console.redwood/observability/sha/a3f9b2
oncall-sre: saw a small increase in 95th latency (+12ms) during the canary window around prefix-caching. not alarming but tagging @eng-runtime for follow-up.
Eli: that latency blip is due to cache warmup after the shim change; I've got a micro-optim to skip redundant KV reads, will submit PR shortly.
Natasha: for the auth header deprecation policy, legal wants a 30-day notice after we flip the default. we should schedule the feature flag flip and a customer comms draft.
Maya: plan proposal: (1) merged SDK alias + tests, (2) patch backend double-encode bug, (3) run canary 48h, (4) flip default behind org opt-in for 30 days, (5) send notice. agree?
Rohan: agree. tagging reviewers: @Eli for backend, @Natasha for comms sign-off.
Eli: I'll prioritize the backend PR; aiming for a green review in next 6 hrs.
Natasha: I'll draft the comms and post in #customer-success for input. ETA tomorrow morning.
Maya: ops question — any infra changes needed to support the alias header at scale?
oncall-sre: none expected; it's just header parsing. watchlist: api-gateway v2 plugin needs a small schema bump to accept alias name, I can push that as a tiny change.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics after 2h: error-rate 0.03% (baseline 0.02%), median latency +3ms. No regressions in token accounting.
Rohan: heads-up: SDK PR includes a feature flag to disable alias entirely per-org. we'll wire it to account settings later.
Maya: final ask — please post PR links here when ready and ping for quick reviews. we'll hold final deprec date until canary 48h completes and comms ready. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Eli: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1182 (backend fix)
Rohan: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/452 (alias + tests)
Natasha: comms draft -> https://docs.internal/redwood/comms/v2-auth-deprec-draft.md (posting for feedback)
Maya: excellent. I'll update the migration owners doc after these merge.
oncall-sre: noted, monitoring alert adjusted for the canary window. will escalate if >0.1% error rate.
Maya: closing loop for now — if anything blocks reviews ping me directly.
Rohan: pinged reviewers. thanks. :rocket:
